\n\n

The given statement mentions that all newly built residential complexes in the city are required to install solar panels, contributing to the city's goal of achieving 80% renewable energy usage by 2030.

\n\n

Now, let's evaluate the given inferences:

\n\n

Inference I: The city will achieve its goal of 80% renewable energy usage by 2030

\n\n

- This inference is not necessarily true.

\n\n

The statement only says that solar panels contribute to the goal, but it does not guarantee that the goal will be achieved.

\n\n

Inference II: Existing residential complexes are exempt from the solar panel installation requirement -

\n\n

This inference is true.

\n\n

Since the statement specifies only newly built residential complexes are required to install solar panels, it implies that existing complexes are not included in this requirement.

\n\n

Hence, only Inference II follows from the given statement.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

\n\n

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर \"विकल्प 2\" है।

\n+ ಮತ್ತು × ಅನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ 8 ಮತ್ತು 24 ಅನ್ನು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಅದಲುಬದಲು ಮಾಡಿದ ನಂತರ, ನಾವು ಪ್ರತಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

ಈಗ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ: + ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯು × ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ, × ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯು + ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ, 8 ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯು 24 ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ,

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

ಆಯ್ಕೆ 4: (24 + 4) × 8 = 60
\n⇒ (8 × 4) + 24 = 32 + 24 = 56

\n\n

ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ \"ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1\".

The logic followed here is:

Logic: People who like only Tea = Total Tea lovers minus those who like both.
\nPeople who like only Coffee = Total Coffee lovers minus those who like both.
\nThen add both results.

\n\n

Now,

Only Tea = 60 − 40 = 20

\n\n

Total who like only one of them = 20 + 30 = 50

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.

The logic followed here is:

\n\n

Logic: To strengthen the argument, we must choose the option that provides direct evidence that a similar policy improves public health outcomes.

\n\n

Now, checking the Options:

\n\n

Option 1: A survey shows that most residents dislike the taste of diet sodas
\n– Irrelevant to health impact or effectiveness of the ban.

\n\n

Option 2: Data from a neighboring city shows a decrease in obesity rates after implementing a similar ban
\n– Direct evidence that the policy improves health outcomes; strongly supports the argument.

\n\n

Option 3: The ban would primarily affect small, independent grocery stores rather than large chains
\n– Focuses on economic impact, not health benefits.

\n\n

Option 4: The tax revenue generated from the remaining smaller sugary beverages would increase slightly
\n– Financial aspect, not related to health improvement.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.

यहाँ अनुसरण किया गया तर्क है:

\n\n

तर्क: तर्क को मजबूत करने के लिए, हमें उस विकल्प को चुनना होगा जो प्रत्यक्ष साक्ष्य प्रदान करता है कि इसी तरह की नीति सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य परिणामों में सुधार करती है।

\n\n

अब, विकल्पों की जाँच करते हैं:

\n\n

विकल्प 1: एक सर्वेक्षण से पता चलता है कि अधिकांश निवासियों को डाइट सोडा का स्वाद नापसंद है
\n- स्वास्थ्य प्रभाव या प्रतिबंध की प्रभावशीलता के लिए अप्रासंगिक है।

\n\n

विकल्प 2: एक पड़ोसी शहर के डेटा से पता चलता है कि इसी तरह के प्रतिबंध को लागू करने के बाद मोटापे की दर में कमी आई है
\n- प्रत्यक्ष साक्ष्य कि नीति स्वास्थ्य परिणामों में सुधार करती है; तर्क का दृढ़ता से समर्थन करता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 3: यह प्रतिबंध बड़ी श्रृंखलाओं के बजाय मुख्य रूप से छोटे, स्वतंत्र किराना स्टोरों को प्रभावित करेगा
\n- आर्थिक प्रभाव पर केंद्रित है, स्वास्थ्य लाभों पर नहीं।

\n\n

विकल्प 4: शेष छोटे शर्करा युक्त पेय पदार्थों से उत्पन्न कर राजस्व में थोड़ी वृद्धि होगी
\n- वित्तीय पहलू, स्वास्थ्य सुधार से संबंधित नहीं है।

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

The logic followed here is:

\n\n

Logic: To strengthen the argument, we must choose the option that shows reducing sick leave or incentivizing attendance actually improves productivity or justifies removing sick leave policy.

Now, checking th\ne Options:

\n\n

Option 1: Studies show that the majority of sick leave taken is actually due to minor ailments that don't require time off
\n– Supports the idea that sick leave may be overused; strengthens the argument.

\n\n

Option 2: Employees who frequently take sick leave often feel guilty about missing work
\n– Emotional point, but does not justify policy change or productivity improvement.

\n\n

Option 3: The cost of processing sick leave claims is very low for large companies
\n– Weakens the argument since it suggests no need to eliminate sick leave.

\n\n

Option 4: Offering attendance bonuses is a common practice in smaller, less productive firms
\n– Suggests the policy is linked with lower productivity; does not support the claim for large companies.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.

\n\n

\n\n

विकल्प 1: अध्ययनों से पता चलता है कि ली गई अधिकांश बीमारी की छुट्टियां वास्तव में मामूली बीमारियों के कारण होती हैं जिनके लिए छुट्टी की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है

\n\n

विकल्प 2: जो कर्मचारी अक्सर बीमारी की छुट्टी लेते हैं, वे अक्सर काम से अनुपस्थित रहने के कारण दोषी महसूस करते हैं
\n- भावनात्मक बिंदु, लेकिन नीतिगत बदलाव या उत्पादकता में सुधार को उचित नहीं ठहराता है।

\n\n

\n- तर्क को कमजोर करता है क्योंकि यह सुझाव देता है कि बीमारी के अवकाश को समाप्त करने की कोई आवश्यकता नहीं है।

\n\n

विकल्प 4: उपस्थिति बोनस की पेशकश करना छोटी, कम उत्पादक फर्मों में एक आम बात है

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

4 triangles formed by combining different adjacent sections of the figure.

8 triangles formed by combining multiple sections into larger triangles.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.

यहाँ अनुसरित तर्क इस प्रकार है:

\n\n

तर्क: संबंध प्रत्येक आकृति को बनाने वाले रेखाखंडों की संख्या पर आधारित है। पहले युग्म में, एक वर्ग (4 रेखाखंड) को 3 रेखाखंडों से बनी एक खुली आकृति के साथ युग्मित किया गया है, जो n : n − 1 का स्वरूप दर्शाता है। दूसरे युग्म में भी यही संबंध बनाए रखा जाना चाहिए।

\n\n

\n\n

अब, विकल्पों की जाँच करने पर:

\n\n

विकल्प 1:
\nआवश्यक 4 : 3 और 3 : 2 संरचना में बेमेल → नियम का अनुसरण नहीं करता है

\n\n

विकल्प 2:
\nएक रेखाखंड की निरंतर कमी को बनाए नहीं रखता है → नियम को तोड़ता है

\n\n

विकल्प 3:
\nवर्ग (4 रेखाएँ) को 3-रेखा वाली आकृति के साथ युग्मित किया गया है, और त्रिभुज (3 रेखाएँ) को 2-रेखा वाले कोण के साथ युग्मित किया गया है → नियम का अनुसरण करता है (4 : 3 :: 3 : 2)

\n\n

विकल्प 4:
\nआवश्यक रेखाखंड प्रगति को बनाए नहीं रखता है → नियम को तोड़ता है

\n\n

अतः, विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

\n– Conditional selection is not allowed as requirements must be met at the time of application.

\n\n

यहाँ अनुसरण किया गया तर्क इस प्रकार है:

\n\n

तर्क: एक उम्मीदवार को सभी पात्रता शर्तों को पूरी तरह से संतुष्ट करना चाहिए। यदि कोई अनिवार्य मानदंड पूरा नहीं होता है, तो उम्मीदवार को सीधे अस्वीकार कर दिया जाना चाहिए।

\n\n

अब, विकल्पों की जाँच करने पर:

\n\n

विकल्प 1: मामला मानव संसाधन (HR) प्रबंधक को भेजें
\n- अनावश्यक है क्योंकि पात्रता स्पष्ट रूप से पूरी नहीं हुई है।

\n\n

विकल्प 2: आवेदन अस्वीकार करें
\n- सही है, क्योंकि विवेक की टाइपिंग गति 35 WPM है (आवश्यक 40 WPM से कम) और वह न्यूनतम 1-वर्ष के अनुबंध के लिए भी प्रतिबद्ध नहीं है।

\n\n

विकल्प 3: उम्मीदवार का अनंतिम रूप से चयन करें
\n- मान्य नहीं है क्योंकि मूल पात्रता मानदंड संतुष्ट नहीं हैं।

\n\n

विकल्प 4: चयन करें, बशर्ते वह अपनी टाइपिंग गति में तुरंत सुधार करे
\n- सशर्त चयन की अनुमति नहीं है क्योंकि आवेदन के समय आवश्यकताओं को पूरा किया जाना चाहिए।

The logic followed here is:

\n\n

Add the numbers in each column and check if the sum is a perfect square.

\n\n

\n\n

Column A:
\n= 6 + 11 + 8
\n= 25 (Perfect square )

\n\n

Column B:
\n= 1 + 4 + 3
\n= 8 (Not a perfect square)

\n\n

Column C:
\n= 5 + 2 + 11
\n= 18 (Not a perfect square)

\n\n

Column D:
\n= 8 + 4 + 1
\n= 13 (Not a perfect square)

\n\n

So, Column A has a perfect square sum.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

The logic followed here is:

\n\n

Logic: The most effective response to an environmental violation is the one that ensures formal action through proper authorities, leading to investigation and enforcement of rules.

\n\n

Now, checking the Options:

\n\n

Option 1: Stop visiting the cafe and tell your friends to do the same
\n– Indirect and ineffective; does not address the violation.

\n\n

Option 2: Send an anonymous letter to the cafe owner, warning them to cease their actions
\n– May or may not be acted upon; no enforcement mechanism.

\n\n

Option 3: Submit an official complaint to the local health or public works department
\n– Correct approach; ensures investigation and legal action if needed.

\n\n

Option 4: Place a large sign by the storm drain warning against pollution
\n– Symbolic action; does not ensure compliance.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.

यहाँ निम्नलिखित तर्क का अनुसरण किया गया है:

\n\n

तर्क: किसी पर्यावरणीय उल्लंघन के प्रति सबसे प्रभावी प्रतिक्रिया वह है जो उचित अधिकारियों के माध्यम से औपचारिक कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करती है, जिससे जाँच होती है और नियमों को लागू किया जाता है।

\n\n

अब, विकल्पों की जाँच करते हैं:

\n\n

विकल्प 1: कैफे में जाना बंद कर दें और अपने दोस्तों को भी ऐसा ही करने के लिए कहें
\n- अप्रत्यक्ष और अप्रभावी; यह उल्लंघन का समाधान नहीं करता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 2: कैफे के मालिक को एक गुमनाम पत्र भेजें, जिसमें उन्हें अपनी हरकतों को रोकने की चेतावनी दी गई हो
\n- इस पर कार्रवाई हो भी सकती है और नहीं भी; कोई प्रवर्तन तंत्र नहीं है।

\n\n

विकल्प 3: स्थानीय स्वास्थ्य या लोक निर्माण विभाग में आधिकारिक शिकायत दर्ज करें
\n- सही दृष्\nटिकोण; यदि आवश्यक हो तो जाँच और कानूनी कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 4: प्रदूषण के विरुद्ध चेतावनी देने के लिए बरसाती नाले के पास एक बड़ा बोर्ड लगाएँ
\n- प्रतीकात्मक कार्रवाई; अनुपालन सुनिश्चित नहीं करता है।

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

The logic followed here is:

\n\n

Logic: The most responsible professional response to unethical inducement in healthcare is to follow formal ethical and regulatory reporting channels, ensuring accountability and patient safety.

\n\n

Now, checking the Options:

\n\n

Option 1: Accept the trip but continue to prescribe the medication you believe is best for the patient
\n– Highly unethical; creates conflict of interest and violates professional integrity.

\n\n

Option 2: Politely decline the offer and warn the representative not to do it again
\n– Refuses the offer but fails to ensure accountability or prevent future misconduct.

\n\n

Option 3: Inform your professional peers about the offer so they can avoid the representative
\n– Informative but informal; does not address the issue through proper authority.

\n\n

Option 4: Report the representative's unethical solicitation to the Compliance Officer or Medical Licensing Board
\n– Correct approach; ensures formal investigation and enforcement of ethical standards.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.

विकल्प 1: यात्रा को स्वीकार करें लेकिन उस दवा को निर्धारित करना जारी रखें जिसे आप रोगी के लिए सर्वोत्तम मानते हैं
\n- अत्यधिक अनैतिक; हितों का टकराव (conflict of interest) पैदा करता है और पेशेवर सत्यनिष्ठा का उल्लंघन करता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 2: प्रस्ताव को विनम्रतापूर्वक अस्वीकार करें और प्रतिनिधि को चेतावनी दें कि वह ऐसा दोबारा न करे
\n- प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार करता है लेकिन जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करने या भविष्य के कदाचार को रोकने में विफल रहता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 3: अपने पेशेवर साथियों को प्रस्ताव के बारे में सूचित करें ताकि वे प्रत\nिनिधि से बच सकें
\n- सूचनात्मक लेकिन अनौपचारिक; उचित प्राधिकारी के माध्यम से समस्या का समाधान नहीं करता है।

\n\n

विकल्प 4: अनुपालन अधिकारी या चिकित्सा अनुज्ञापन बोर्ड को प्रतिनिधि की अनैतिक याचना की रिपोर्ट करें
\n- सही दृष्टिकोण; औपचारिक जांच और नैतिक मानकों का प्रवर्तन सुनिश्चित करता है।

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

\n\n

Logic: In research ethics, the correct action is to ensure data integrity, transparency, and accurate reporting, even if it conflicts with desired outcomes or funding pressures.

\n\n

Now, checking the Options:

\n\n

Option 1: Remove the contradictory data points as instructed by your team leader to secure future funding
\n– Unethical; involves data manipulation and falsification.

\n\n

Option 2: Refuse to remove the valid data, present the results accurately, and document your disagreement with the team leader in your internal notes
\n– Correct approach; maintains scientific integrity and provides transparency with proper documentation.

\n\n

Option 3: Remove the data, but anonymously leak the original raw data to a friendly scientist outside the team
\n– Still unethical; involves data manipulation and improper disclosure.

\n\n

Option 4: Present only the raw data without any analysis and let the funding agency draw its own conclusion
\n– Incomplete scientific communication; analysis is part of responsible reporting.

\n\n

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.

विकल्प 4: बिना किसी विश्लेषण के केवल मूल डेटा प्रस्तुत करें और वित्तपोषण एजेंसी को अपना निष्कर्ष स्वयं निकालने दें।

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

\n\n

दिया गया कथन:

\n\n

कोई भी युवा जो विवाह के लिए दहेज को एक शर्त बनाता है, वह स्वयं को कलंकित करता है और नारीत्व का अपमान करता है।

\n\n

निष्कर्ष:

\n\n

I. जो लोग विवाह में दहेज लेते हैं, समाज द्वारा उनकी निंदा की जानी चाहिए - अनुसरण नहीं करता है (कथन कहता है कि वे स्वयं को कलंकित करते हैं, लेकिन यह उल्लेख नहीं करता है कि समाज को उनकी निंदा करनी चाहिए।)

\n\n

II. जो लोग विवाह में दहेज नहीं लेते हैं, वे नारीत्व का सम्मान करते हैं - अनुसरण नहीं करता है (दहेज की मांग का न होना स्वतः ही नारीत्व के प्रति सम्मान को सिद्ध नहीं करता है।)

\n\n

इसलिए, न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही II अनुसरण करता है।

Option 1: यहाँ अनुसरण किया गया तर्क इस प्रकार है:

\n\n

Logic: आकृतियों 1, 2, 3, और 4 में, पंखुड़ी जैसी आकृति के छायांकित (shaded) और अछायांकित (unshaded) क्षेत्र एक सुसंगत घूर्णी पैटर्न (rotational pattern) बनाए रखते हैं। जब आकृतियों को घुमाया जाता है, तो केंद्रीय वक्र के सापेक्ष छायांकित भाग की स्थिति अपरिवर्तित रहती है, जिसका अर्थ है कि ये सभी आकृतियाँ घूर्णन की दृष्टि से समान हैं।

\n\n

\n\n

अब, विकल्पों की जाँच करते हैं:

\n\n

विकल्प 1:
\nवक्र के संबंध में छायांकित क्षेत्र का सही अभिविन्यास बनाए रखता है → नियम का पालन करता है

\n\n

विकल्प 2:
\nसमान अभिविन्यास पैटर्न से मेल खाने के लिए घुमाया जा सकता है → नियम का पालन करता है

\n\n

विकल्प 3:
\nयह भी समान घूर्णी समरूपता पैटर्न से मेल खाता है → नियम का पालन करता है

\n\n

विकल्प 4:
\nवक्र के सापेक्ष छायांकित और अछायांकित क्षेत्र उल्टे हैं → घूर्णन द्वारा प्राप्त नहीं किया जा सकता (यह एक दर्पण छवि है) → नियम तोड़ता है → विषम आकृति

\n\n

अतः, विकल्प 4 विषम आकृति है।

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) index was an influential annual report published by the World Bank Group that ranked 190 economies based on how easy it was for local firms to conduct business.
      • \n\t
    • The index measured business regulations across 10 specific parameters: Starting a Business, Dealing with Construction Permits, Getting Electricity, Registering Property, Getting Credit, Protecting Minority Investors, Paying Taxes, Trading across Borders, Enforcing Contracts, and Resolving Insolvency.
      • \n\t
    • Starting a business is a core parameter that tracks the number of procedures, time, cost, and paid-in minimum capital required for a small-to-medium-sized enterprise to begin operations.
      • \n\t
    • Military spending refers to the financial resources allocated by a nation to maintain its armed forces and national security; this is a macroeconomic/defense metric and does not relate to the regulatory efficiency of the business environment.
      • \n\t
    • While the World Bank discontinued the Doing Business report in September 2021 due to data irregularities, the parameters remain significant for studying global economic competitiveness.
      • \n
    \n\n

     Additional Information

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Starting a business:\n\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Focuses on the bureaucratic hurdles faced by entrepreneurs during the pre-incorporation and incorporation phases.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Getting electricity:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Measures the procedures, time, and cost to obtain a permanent commercial electricity connection for a newly constructed warehouse.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Paying taxes:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Evaluates the Total Tax Rate, the number of payments per year, and the hours spent complying with tax laws, including VAT and corporate income tax.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • The World Bank has introduced a new benchmarking tool called Business Ready (B-READY) to replace the legacy EoDB index, emphasizing digitalization and sustainability.
      • \n

      • \n\t
    • सूचकांक ने 10 विशिष्ट मापदंडों के आधार पर व्यावसायिक नियमों को मापा: व्यवसाय शुरू करना, निर्माण अनुमति प्राप्त करना, बिजली प्राप्त करना, संपत्ति का पंजीकरण करना, ऋण प्राप्त करना, अल्पसंख्यक निवेशकों की रक्षा करना, करों का भुगतान करना, सीमा पार व्यापार करना, अनुबंधों को लागू करना और दिवाला समाधान।
      • \n\t
    • व्यवसाय शुरू करना एक मुख्य मापदंड है जो एक छोटे से मध्यम आकार के उद्यम को परिचालन शुरू करने के लिए आवश्यक प्रक्रियाओं की संख्या, समय, लागत और भुगतान की गई न्यूनतम पूंजी को निगरानी  करता है।
      • \n\t
    • सैन्य खर्च से तात्पर्य किसी राष्ट्र द्वारा अपने सशस्त्र बलों और राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा को बनाए रखने के लिए आवंटित वित्तीय संसाधनों से है; यह एक व्यापक अर्थव्यवस्थात्मक/रक्षा मापदंड  है और व्यावसायिक वातावरण की नियामक दक्षता से संबंधित नहीं है।
      • \n\t
    • हालांकि विश्व बैंक ने आँकड़े अनियमितताओं के कारण सितंबर 2021 में डूइंग बिजनेस रिपोर्ट को बंद कर दिया था, लेकिन वैश्विक आर्थिक प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता के अध्ययन के लिए ये मापदंड महत्वपूर्ण बने हुए हैं।

    \n\n54:Teca,\nThe correct answer is Alternative dispute resolution.\n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) refers to a collection of processes, including mediation, arbitration, and conciliation, that allow parties to settle disputes outside the formal courtroom environment.
      • \n\t
    • It is significantly faster than traditional litigation because it avoids the procedural complexities, pre-trial motions, and congested court dockets that often delay cases for years.
      • \n\t
    • In commercial disputes, ADR offers a flexible schedule where parties can choose their own neutral third party who possesses specific industry expertise, leading to more efficient and relevant outcomes.
      • \n\t
    • These methods focus on collaborative problem-solving rather than adversarial competition, which helps in reaching a resolution in a fraction of the time required for judicial proceedings.
      • \n\t
    • Settlements reached through Arbitration are often legally binding and enforceable under national laws like the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, providing the same legal security as a court order but with greater speed.
      • \n
    \n\n

     Additional Information

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Core Components of ADR:\n\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Arbitration: A formal process where an arbitratorAlternative dispute resolution.\n\n

        Key Points

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) refers to a collection of processes, including mediation, arbitration, and conciliation, that allow parties to settle disputes outside the formal courtroom environment.
          • \n\t
        • It is significantly faster than traditional litigation because it avoids the procedural complexities, pre-trial motions, and congested court dockets that often delay cases for years.
          • \n\t
        • In commercial disputes, ADR offers a flexible schedule where parties can choose their own neutral third party who possesses specific industry expertise, leading to more efficient and relevant outcomes.
          • \n\t
        • These methods focus on collaborative problem-solving rather than adversarial competition, which helps in reaching a resolution in a fraction of the time required for judicial proceedings.
          • \n\t
        • Settlements reached through Arbitration are often legally binding and enforceable under national laws like the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, providing the same legal security as a court order but with greater speed.
          • \n
        \n\n

         Additional Information

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Core Components of ADR:\n\n\t
            \n\t\t
          • Arbitration: A formal process where an arbitrator hears both sides and issues a binding decision known as an award. It is commonly used in international trade.
            • \n\t\t
          • Mediation: A non-binding, confidential process where a mediator assists parties in reaching a voluntary agreement without imposing a decision.
            • \n\t\t
          • Confidentiality: Unlike public trials, ADR keeps sensitive business data and trade secrets private, protecting the brand reputation of the companies involved.
            • \n\t\t
          • Cost-Effectiveness: By reducing legal billable hours and eliminating court fees, ADR significantly lowers the administrative costs of conflict resolution.
            • \n\t
          \n\t
          • \n
        ", "hn": "\nसही उत्तर वैकल्पिक विवाद समाधान (Alternative dispute resolution) है।\n\n

        Key Points 

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • वैकल्पिक विवाद समाधान (ADR) प्रक्रियाओं के एक संग्रह को संदर्भित करता है, जिसमें मध्यस्थता (mediation), पंचाट (arbitration), और सुलह (conciliation) शामिल हैं, जो पक्षों को औपचारिक अदालती वातावरण के बाहर विवादों को निपटाने की अनुमति देते हैं।
          • \n\t
        • यह पारंपरिक मुकदमेबाजी की तुलना में काफी तेज़ है क्योंकि यह प्रक्रियात्मक जटिलताओं, परीक्षण-पूर्व प्रस्तावों और भीड़भाड़ वाले न्यायालयीय प्रकरण-सूची से बचता है जो अक्सर मामलों में वर्षों की देरी करते हैं।
          • \n\t
        • व्यावसायिक विवादों में, ADR एक लचीला कार्यक्रम प्रदान करता है जहाँ पक्ष अपना स्वयं का तटस्थ तीसरा पक्ष चुन सकते हैं जिसके पास विशिष्ट उद्योग विशेषज्ञता हो, जिससे अधिक कुशल और प्रासंगिक परिणाम प्राप्त होते हैं।
          • \n\t
        • ये विधियाँ प्रतिकूल प्रतिस्पर्धा के बजाय सहयोगात्मक समस्या-समाधान पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती हैं, जो न्यायिक कार्यवाही के लिए आवश्यक समय के एक अंश में समाधान तक पहुँचने में मदद करती हैं।
          • \n\t
        • पंचाट (Arbitration) के माध्यम से किए गए समझौते अक्सर पंचाट और सुलह अधिनियम जैसे राष्ट्रीय कानूनों के तहत कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी और लागू करने योग्य होते हैं, जो अदालत के आदेश के समान ही कानूनी सुरक्षा प्रदान करते हैं लेकिन अधिक गति के साथ।
          • \n
        \n\n

        Additional Information 

        \n\n
          \n\t

        \n\n56:T12b7,\nThe correct answer is Statutory liquidity ratio.\n\n

        Key Points

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is a quantitative monetary policy tool used by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) that mandates commercial banks to maintain a specific proportion of their Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) in the form of liquid assets.
          • \n\t
        • These liquid assets must be kept in the form of gold, cash, or unencumbered government securities (such as Treasury Bills and Dated Securities) before the bank can offer credit to its customers.
          • \n\t
        • The primary legal authority for SLR is derived from Section 24 (2A) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, which empowers the central bank to set and adjust this limit to ensure the solvency and liquidity of the banking system.
          • \n\t
        • By adjusting the SLR, the RBI can control the expansion of bank credit; an increase in SLR forces banks to invest more in government securities, thereby reducing the funds available for lending to the private sector and helping to curb inflation.
          • \n\t
        • Unlike the Cash Reserve Ratio, the assets under SLR are maintained by the banks themselves rather than being deposited with the RBI, and banks earn interest on the securities held under this requirement.
          • \n
        \n\n

         Statutory liquidity ratio.\n\n

        Key Points

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is a quantitative monetary policy tool used by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) that mandates commercial banks to maintain a specific proportion of their Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) in the form of liquid assets.
          • \n\t
        • These liquid assets must be kept in the form of gold, cash, or unencumbered government securities (such as Treasury Bills and Dated Securities) before the bank can offer credit to its customers.
          • \n\t
        • The primary legal authority for SLR is derived from Section 24 (2A) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, which empowers the central bank to set and adjust this limit to ensure the solvency and liquidity of the banking system.
          • \n\t
        • By adjusting the SLR, the RBI can control the expansion of bank credit; an increase in SLR forces banks to invest more in government securities, thereby reducing the funds available for lending to the private sector and helping to curb inflation.
          • \n\t
        • Unlike the Cash Reserve Ratio, the assets under SLR are maintained by the banks themselves rather than being deposited with the RBI, and banks earn interest on the securities held under this requirement.
          • \n
        \n\n

         Additional Information

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR):\n\n\t
            \n\t\t
          • Refers to the share of Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that commercial banks are mandated to maintain with the RBI strictly in the form of liquid cash.
            • \n\t\t
          • The RBI does not pay any interest on the amount maintained as CRR, and it serves as a primary tool to regulate liquidity and money supply in the economy.
            • \n\t
          \n\t
          • \n\t
        • Current Ratio:\n\t
            \n\t\t
          • A liquidity ratio that measures a company's ability to pay its short-term obligations or those due within one year.
            • \n\t\t
          • It is calculated by dividing current assets by current liabilities and is a key indicator of financial health for non-banking corporations.
            • \n\t
          \n\t
          • \n\t
        • Margin Requirement:\n\t
            \n\t\t
          • A qualitative monetary policy instrument that refers to the difference between the market value of collateral offered for a loan and the actual loan amount sanctioned.
            • \n\t\t
          • By increasing the margin ratio, the central bank can discourage borrowing for speculative purposes in specific sectors of the economy.
            • \n\t
          \n\t
          • \n

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • Akbar, the third Mughal Emperor, is renowned for his policies of religious tolerance and administrative innovations that aimed to unify a diverse Indian population.
              • \n\t
            • In 1564, he officially abolished the Jizya tax, which was a per capita tax levied on non-Muslim subjects, known as dhimmis, living under Islamic rule.
              • \n\t
            • This significant reform was rooted in Akbar’s philosophy of Sulh-i-kul (universal peace), which sought to provide equal status to all citizens regardless of their religious beliefs.
              • \n\t
            • The abolition of Jizya followed his decision in 1563 to end the Pilgrimage Tax, a levy on Hindus visiting holy sites, further consolidating his image as a liberal and secular monarch.
              • \n\t
            • By removing these financial burdens, Akbar secured the loyalty of the Rajputs and the broader Hindu majority, which was essential for the expansion and stability of the Mughal Empire.

            • This significant reform was rooted in Akbar’s philosophy of Sulh-i-kul (universal peace), which sought to provide equal status to all citizens regardless of their religious beliefs.
              • \n\t
            • The abolition of Jizya followed his decision in 1563 to end the Pilgrimage Tax, a levy on Hindus visiting holy sites, further consolidating his image as a liberal and secular monarch.
              • \n\t
            • By removing these financial burdens, Akbar secured the loyalty of the Rajputs and the broader Hindu majority, which was essential for the expansion and stability of the Mughal Empire.
              • \n
            \n\n

             Additional Information

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • Humayun:\n\n\t

              \n\t
              • \n\t
            • Jahangir:\n\t
                \n\t\t

                • \n\t
              \n\t
              • \n\t

              Key Points

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • Gatka is a traditional martial art form that originated in the Punjab region of India and is deeply rooted in the history of the Sikh community.
                • \n\t
              • It is essentially a style of stick-fighting that employs wooden sticks, known as Soti, and leather shields, called Phari, to simulate sword combat.
                • \n\t
              • The practice was formally introduced and encouraged by Guru Hargobind Ji, the Sixth Sikh Guru, who advocated for the militarization of Sikhs for self-defense and justice.
                • \n\t
              • It reached its peak under the Tenth Sikh Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji, who mandated martial training for the Khalsa warriors in the late 17th century.
                • \n\t
              • The art transitioned from a battlefield technique to a performance art and competitive sport during the British colonial period when the use of traditional weapons was restricted.
                • \n\t
              • Today, Gatka is an integral part of Sikh festivals and religious processions, especially during Hola Mohalla and Vaisakhi.
                • \n
              \n\n

               Additional Information

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • Indigenous Sports Promotion:\n\n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • The Government of India has officially recognized Gatka as a competitive sport, including it in the Khelo India Youth Games to preserve its cultural heritage.
                  • \n\t\t
                • Other traditional martial arts promoted alongside it include Kalaripayattu from Kerala, Thang-Ta from Manipur, and Mallakhamba from Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.
                  • \n\t
                \n\t
                • \n\t
              • Regional Martial Traditions:\n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • Haryana: Predominantly famous for Kushti (traditional wrestling), making it a powerhouse for Olympic sports in India.
                  • \n\t\t
                • Rajasthan: Known for Shastar Vidya and various Rajput warrior traditions involving swordsmanship and archery.
                  • \n\t\t
                • Gujarat: While not known for a combat martial art like Gatka, it is famous for Dandiya Raas, which utilizes sticks for rhythmic folk dance.
                  • \n\t
                \n\t

              ", "hn": "\nसही उत्तर पंजाब है।\n\n

              Key Points 

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • गतका एक पारंपरिक मार्शल आर्ट (युद्ध कला) रूप है जिसकी उत्पत्ति भारत के पंजाब क्षेत्र में हुई थी और यह सिख समुदाय के इतिहास में गहराई से निहित है।
                • \n\t
              • यह अनिवार्य रूप से लाठी-युद्ध की एक शैली है जिसमें तलवारबाजी का अनुकरण करने के लिए लकड़ी की छड़ियों, जिन्हें सोटी कहा जाता है, और चमड़े की ढालों, जिन्हें फारी कहा जाता है, का उपयोग किया जाता है।
                • \n\t
              • इस अभ्यास को औपचारिक रूप से छठे सिख गुरु, गुरु हरगोबिंद जी द्वारा पेश और प्रोत्साहित किया गया था, जिन्होंने आत्मरक्षा और न्याय के लिए सिखों के सैन्यीकरण की वकालत की थी।
                • \n\t
              • यह दसवें सिख गुरु, गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी के अधीन अपने चरम पर पहुँचा, जिन्होंने 17वीं शताब्दी के अंत में खालसा योद्धाओं के लिए युद्ध प्रशिक्षण अनिवार्य कर दिया था।
                • \n\t
              • ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान यह कला युद्ध के मैदान की तकनीक से एक प्रदर्शन कला और प्रतिस्पर्धी खेल में बदल गई, जब पारंपरिक हथियारों के उपयोग पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया गया था।
                • \n\t
              • आज, गतका सिख त्योहारों और धार्मिक जुलूसों का एक अभिन्न अंग है, विशेष रूप से होला मोहल्ला और बैसाखी के दौरान।
                • \n
              \n\n

              Additional Information 

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • स्वदेशी खेलों को बढ़ावा देना:\n\n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • भारत सरकार ने आधिकारिक तौर पर गतका को एक प्रतिस्पर्धी खेल के रूप में मान्यता दी है, और इसकी सांस्कृतिक विरासत को संरक्षित करने के लिए इसे भारत युवा खेल प्रतियोगिता में शामिल किया है।
                  • \n\t\t
                • इसके साथ ही बढ़ावा दी जाने वाली अन्य पारंपरिक युद्ध कलाओं में केरल की कलारीपयट्टू, मणिपुर की थांग-टा, और मध्य प्रदेश और महाराष्ट्र की मल्लखंब शामिल हैं।
                  • \n\t
                \n\t
                • \n\t
              • क्षेत्रीय युद्ध  परंपराएं:\n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • हरियाणा: मुख्य रूप से कुश्ती (पारंपरिक कुश्ती) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जो इसे भारत में ओलंपिक खेलों के लिए एक शक्ति केंद्र बनाता है।
                  • \n\t\t
                • राजस्थान: शस्त्र विद्या और तलवारबाजी और तीरंदाजी से जुड़ी विभिन्न राजपूत योद्धा परंपराओं के लिए जाना जाता है।
                  • \n\t\t
                • गुजरात: हालांकि यह गतका जैसी युद्ध कला के लिए नहीं जाना जाता है, लेकिन यह डांडिया रास के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जिसमें लयबद्ध लोक नृत्य के लिए छड़ियों का उपयोग किया जाता है।
                  • \n\t

                • \n\t
              • The event takes place in slushy paddy fields filled with mud and water, where a pair of buffaloes are driven by a jockey over a distance of approximately 100 to 160 meters.
                • \n\t
              • Historically, the tradition is believed to be over 800 years old and is deeply associated with the farming community of the Tulu Nadu region.
                • \n\t
              • The festival is dedicated to Lord Kadri Manjunatha, an incarnation of Lord Shiva, as a gesture of gratitude for a bountiful harvest and to keep the cattle free from diseases.

              • The racing season typically begins in November and continues until March, featuring various competition categories such as Kane Halage and Hagga Haaki.

                  \n\n60:Tde6,\nThe correct answer is 2.\n\n

                  Key Points

                  \n\n
                    \n\t
                  • Under the standard laws of Table Tennis established by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF), the right to serve alternates between opponents after every 2 points scored.
                    • \n\t
                  • The sequence of service remains constant throughout the game regardless of which player wins the point, ensuring each player receives an equal number of opportunities to initiate play.
                    • \n\t
                  • This rotation continues until the game ends or until the score reaches 10-10, at which point the game enters a phase known as a Deuce.
                    • \n\t
                  • In a standard match, a game is won by the first player or pair to score 11 points, provided there is a margin of at least 2 points over the opponent.
                    • \n\t
                  • The server must strike the ball so that it first touches their court and then touches the receiver's court directly, passing over or around the net assembly.
                    • \n

                  2.\n\n

                  Key Points

                  \n\n
                    \n\t
                  • Under the standard laws of Table Tennis established by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF), the right to serve alternates between opponents after every 2 points scored.
                    • \n\t
                  • The sequence of service remains constant throughout the game regardless of which player wins the point, ensuring each player receives an equal number of opportunities to initiate play.
                    • \n\t
                  • This rotation continues until the game ends or until the score reaches 10-10, at which point the game enters a phase known as a Deuce.
                    • \n\t
                  • In a standard match, a game is won by the first player or pair to score 11 points, provided there is a margin of at least 2 points over the opponent.
                    • \n\t
                  • The server must strike the ball so that it first touches their court and then touches the receiver's court directly, passing over or around the net assembly.
                    • \n
                  \n\n

                   Additional Information

                  \n\n
                    \n\t
                  • Service Exceptions and Variations:\n\n\t
                      \n\t\t
                    • Deuce Scenarios: When the score is tied at 10-10, the sequence of serving and receiving remains the same, but each player shall serve for only 1 point in turn until a lead of 2 points is established.
                      • \n\t\t
                    • Expedite System: If a game is not finished after 10 minutes of play (unless both players have scored at least 9 points), the Expedite System is implemented. Under this rule, service alternates after every single point.
                      • \n\t\t
                    • Doubles Play: The service rotation involves four players. The server first serves to the receiver, then the receiver becomes the server, and the partner of the initial server becomes the new receiver.
                      • \n\t\t
                    • Service Technique: The ball must be placed on the open palm of the stationary free hand and thrown at least 16 cm into the air without imparting spin before being struck.
                      • \n\t
                    \n\t
                    • \n

                      Key Points

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • Gothic architecture is a European architectural style that flourished during the High and Late Middle Ages, specifically from the 12th to the 16th century. It evolved from Romanesque architecture and was eventually succeeded by Renaissance architecture.
                        • \n\t
                      • The pointed arch (or ogival arch) is the defining characteristic of this style. Unlike the rounded arches of earlier periods, the pointed arch allowed for greater height and thinner walls by directing the weight of the structure more vertically.
                        • \n\t
                      • Stained glass windows were extensively used to fill large wall openings, made possible by the structural support of the arches. These windows, including the famous rose windows, were used to illustrate biblical stories and create a luminous, ethereal atmosphere inside Cathedrals.
                        • \n\t
                      • Other fundamental features include ribbed vaults, which supported heavy ceilings with a web of stone ribs, and flying buttresses, which were external stone supports that carried the weight of the high roofs away from the walls.

                      \n\n68:Te36,\nThe correct answer is Ajanta.\n\n

                      Key Points

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • The Ajanta Caves are located in the Aurangabad district of Maharashtra and comprise about 30 rock-cut Buddhist monuments excavated into a basaltic horseshoe-shaped cliff.
                        • \n\t
                      • These caves were developed in two phases, starting from the 2nd century BCE (Satavahana period) and continuing to the 5th and 6th centuries CE (Vakataka period).
                        • \n\t
                      • The site is categorized into two main types of structures: Chaityas, which served as prayer halls containing a stupa, and Viharas, which were monastic residential quarters for monks.
                        • \n\t

                        Key Points

                        \n\n
                          \n\t
                        • Gothic architecture is a European architectural style that flourished during the High and Late Middle Ages, specifically from the 12th to the 16th century. It evolved from Romanesque architecture and was eventually succeeded by Renaissance architecture.
                          • \n\t
                        • The pointed arch (or ogival arch) is the defining characteristic of this style. Unlike the rounded arches of earlier periods, the pointed arch allowed for greater height and thinner walls by directing the weight of the structure more vertically.
                          • \n\t
                        • Stained glass windows were extensively used to fill large wall openings, made possible by the structural support of the arches. These windows, including the famous rose windows, were used to illustrate biblical stories and create a luminous, ethereal atmosphere inside Cathedrals.
                          • \n\t
                        • Other fundamental features include ribbed vaults, which supported heavy ceilings with a web of stone ribs, and flying buttresses, which were external stone supports that carried the weight of the high roofs away from the walls.
                          • \n

                        \n\n
                          \n\t

                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Flat roofs with courtyards:\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • These are characteristic of traditional Indian housing and Mediterranean architecture, designed to improve ventilation and provide private outdoor space in warm climates.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Sloping tiled roofs:\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Commonly found in Vernacular architecture within regions of high rainfall, such as Kerala or the Konkan coast, to facilitate efficient water drainage.

                          \n\t

                        • Historical Examples:\n\t
                            \n\t\t

                              Key Points

                              • Claire Keegan is a distinguished Irish author whose work Small Things Like These achieved significant recognition by being shortlisted for the 2022 Booker Prize.
                                • \n\t
                              • The novella is notably the shortest book in the history of the Booker Prize to ever be shortlisted, containing approximately 116 pages.
                                • \n\t
                              • The narrative is set in 1985 in New Ross, Ireland, and follows the life of Bill Furlong, a coal merchant who uncovers the disturbing secrets of a local Magdalene Laundry run by the church.

                              • While the 2022 Booker Prize featured authors from diverse backgrounds, Claire Keegan represents Ireland and does not have Indian origin, unlike other prominent Booker winners often associated with the region.
                                • \n\t
                              • The book won the Orwell Prize for Political Fiction in 2022 and explores themes of complicity, courage, and social injustice within a small-town religious community.

                                  Key Points

                                  \n\n
                                    \n\t
                                  • The Seventh Five-Year Plan was implemented from 1985 to 1990 under the premiership of Rajiv Gandhi, shifting the economic focus toward modernization and technological self-reliance.
                                    • \n\t
                                  • It is widely credited with laying the groundwork for the 1991 Economic Reforms by introducing concepts of industrial liberalization and reducing the License Raj constraints.
                                    • \n\t
                                  • The plan emphasized Food, Work, and Productivity, aiming to increase efficiency in the private sector while reducing the absolute dominance of the public sector.
                                    • \n\t
                                  • For the first time in Indian planning history, the private sector was given priority over the public sector in terms of investment outlays, creating a precursor to the Market Economy.

                                    \n\t

                                      • \n\t
                                    \n\t
                                    • \n\t

                                      \n\t\t
                                    • Launched in the mid-1960s (specifically 1966) to address food shortages through High-Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds and modern irrigation.
                                      • \n\t\t

                                    \n\t

                                      \n\t\t
                                    • Passed in September 2005 and renamed as MGNREGA in 2009.
                                      • \n\t\t
                                    • This social security measure was a landmark initiative of the Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002−2007).

                                          Key Points

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • Garia Puja is a major harvest festival celebrated in the northeastern state of Tripura, primarily by the Tripuri and Jamatia tribal communities.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • The festival is observed on the seventh day of the Hindu month of Baishakh (usually falling in April) to honor Lord Garia, the deity of livestock, wealth, and prosperity.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • It marks the successful conclusion of the Jhum cultivation cycle (shifting cultivation) and serves as a prayer for a prosperous new agricultural year.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • The ritualistic worship involves a symbolic bamboo pole decorated with garlands and thread, representing the deity, alongside offerings of fowls, eggs, and rice beer.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • A significant highlight is the Garia dance, where performers mimic the actions of agricultural labor and household chores through rhythmic movements and traditional music.
                                            • \n
                                          \n\n

                                           Additional Information

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • Moatsu\n\n\t
                                              \n\t\t
                                            • Celebrated by the Ao Naga tribe of Nagaland in the first week of May.
                                              • \n\t\t
                                            • It signifies the completion of the sowing season and involves community singing and the sharing of rice beer.
                                              • \n\t
                                            \n\t
                                            • \n\t
                                          • Losar\n\t
                                              \n\t\t
                                            • Known as the Tibetan New Year, it is widely celebrated in Arunachal Pradesh (by the Monpa tribe), Ladakh, and Sikkim.
                                              • \n\t\t
                                            • The festivities involve religious rituals at monasteries and traditional dances to ward off evil spirits.
                                              • \n\t
                                            \n\t
                                            • \n\t
                                          • Chapchar Kut\n\t
                                              \n\t\t
                                            • This is the most important festival of Mizoram, celebrated during March.
                                              • \n\t\t
                                            • It occurs after the clearing of forests for Jhum (burning of trees) and features the world-renowned Cheraw or bamboo dance.
                                              • \n\t
                                            \n\t

                                          ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Art and Culture"], "concept": "Art and Culture", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69849b893af6e906b16d999c", "qs_no": 20, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "The primary reason for the British government's decision to partition Bengal in 1905 was:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "To promote the educational development of the region."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">To improve the administrative efficiency of the large province.</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">To foster greater unity between the Hindu and Muslim populations of Bengal.</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">To encourage the growth of industrialization in East Bengal</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "1905 में बंगाल विभाजन के ब्रिटिश सरकार के निर्णय का मुख्य कारण थाः", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">क्षेत्र के शैक्षिक विकास को बढ़ावा देना।</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">बड़े प्रांत की प्रशासनिक दक्षता में सुधार करना।</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">बंगाल की हिंदू और मुस्लिम आबादी के बीच ज्यादा एकता को बढ़ावा देना।</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">&nbsp;पूर्वी बंगाल में औद्योगीकरण के विकास को प्रोत्साहित करना।</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is To improve the administrative efficiency of the large province.\n\n

                                          Key Points

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • The partition of Bengal was officially announced on 19 July 1905 and implemented on 16 October 1905 by Lord Curzon, who served as the Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • The official justification provided by the British Government was that the Bengal Presidency had become too large and populous to be managed by a single administration. It covered an area of about 189,000 square miles with a population of nearly 78 million.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • The restructuring divided the region into two provinces: Western Bengal (comprising present-day West Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha) and Eastern Bengal and Assam, with Dacca (Dhaka) as the capital of the latter.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • While the stated objective was administrative efficiency, the real political motive was to weaken the Indian National Movement and create a communal divide between the Hindu-majority west and the Muslim-majority east.
                                            • \n
                                          \n\n

                                           Additional Information

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • Swadeshi Movement:\n\n\t
                                              \n\t\t
                                            • The partition led to the launch of the Swadeshi Movement, which emphasized the use of indigenous products and the boycott of British-made goods to exert economic pressure on the Raj.
                                              • \n\t\t
                                            • Prominent leaders like Surendranath Banerjee, Bipin Chandra Pal, and Lala Lajpat Rai turned this into a mass struggle for Swaraj (self-rule).

                                          ", "hn": "\nसही उत्तर बड़े प्रांत की प्रशासनिक दक्षता में सुधार करना है।\n\n

                                          Key Points 

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • बंगाल के विभाजन की आधिकारिक घोषणा 19 जुलाई 1905 को की गई थी और इसे 16 अक्टूबर 1905 को लॉर्ड कर्जन द्वारा लागू किया गया था, जिन्होंने 1899 से 1905 तक भारत के वायसराय के रूप में कार्य किया था।

                                              • \n\t

                                          \n\n7a:T1097,\nThe correct answer is It granted the princely states the freedom to choose whether to join India, Pakistan, or remain independent..\n\n

                                          Key Points

                                          \n\n
                                            \n\t
                                          • The Indian Independence Act of 1947 was a landmark legislation passed by the British Parliament that set the date for the partition of British India into two sovereign dominions: India and Pakistan.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • A primary provision regarding the princely states was the termination of British Paramountcy. This meant that all treaties, agreements, and obligations between the British Crown and the rulers of these states lapsed on August 15, 1947.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • The Act did not mandate the integration of states based on geography; instead, it legally provided the 562 princely states with the choice to accede to either of the two new dominions or to remain independent.
                                            • \n\t
                                          • This legal framework meant that the states were no longer under the suzerainty of the British monarch and were technically restored to the status they held before their treaties with the British.
                                            • \n
                                          \n\n

                                          • Integration Process:\n\n\t
                                              \n\t\t
                                            • Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the first Home Minister of India, and V.P. Menon played a monumental role in the political integration of these states.

                                              \nरियासतों के संबंध में इस अधिनियम का मुख्य प्रावधान निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा था?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">इसमें भौगोलिक निकटता के आधार पर सभी रियासतों को भारत या पाकिस्तान में तत्काल शामिल करने का आदेश दिया गया।</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">इसने रियासतों को यह चुनने की स्वतंत्रता दी कि वे भारत, पाकिस्तान में शामिल हों या स्वतंत्र रहें।</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">इसमें यह प्रावधान किया गया कि ब्रिटिश सरकार रियासतों पर सर्वोच्चता बनाए रखेगी।</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">इसने यह सुनिश्चित किया कि रियासतों और नये उपनिवेशों के बीच राजस्व बंटवारे के समझौते अपरिवर्तित रहेंगे।</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is It granted the princely states the freedom to choose whether to join India, Pakistan, or remain independent..\n\n

                                              Key Points

                                              \n\n
                                                \n\t
                                              • The Indian Independence Act of 1947 was a landmark legislation passed by the British Parliament that set the date for the partition of British India into two sovereign dominions: India and Pakistan.
                                                • \n\t
                                              • A primary provision regarding the princely states was the termination of British Paramo", "hn": "\nसही उत्तर इसने रियासतों को यह चुनने की स्वतंत्रता दी कि वे भारत या पाकिस्तान में शामिल हों, या स्वतंत्र रहें। है।\n\n

                                                Key Points 

                                                \n\n
                                                  \n\t
                                                • भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम 1947 ब्रिटिश संसद द्वारा पारित एक ऐतिहासिक कानून था जिसने ब्रिटिश भारत को दो संप्रभु अधिराज्यों: भारत और पाकिस्तान में विभाजित करने की तिथि निर्धारित की थी।
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • रियासतों के संबंध में एक प्राथमिक प्रावधान ब्रिटिश सर्वोच्चता (British Paramountcy) की समाप्ति थी। इसका अर्थ यह था कि ब्रिटिश राजमुकुट और इन राज्यों के शासकों के बीच सभी संधियाँ, समझौते और दायित्व 15 अगस्त, 1947 को समाप्त हो गए।
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • अधिनियम ने भूगोल के आधार पर राज्यों के एकीकरण को अनिवार्य नहीं किया; इसके बजाय, इसने कानूनी रूप से 562 रियासतों को दो नए अधिराज्यों में से किसी एक में शामिल होने या स्वतंत्र रहने का विकल्प प्रदान किया।
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • इस कानूनी ढांचे का मतलब था कि राज्य अब ब्रिटिश सम्राट के आधिपत्य के अधीन नहीं थे और तकनीकी रूप से उसी स्थिति में बहाल हो गए थे जो अंग्रेजों के साथ उनकी संधियों से पहले थी।
                                                  • \n

                                                Additional Information 

                                                \n\n
                                                  \n\t
                                                • एकीकरण प्रक्रिया:\n\n\t
                                                    \n\t\t
                                                  • भारत के पहले गृह मंत्री सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल और वी.पी. मेनन ने इन राज्यों के राजनीतिक एकीकरण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।
                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                  • विलय पत्र (Instrument of Accession) वह कानूनी दस्तावेज था जिसके माध्यम से शासक भारत में शामिल होने के लिए सहमत हुए, आमतौर पर रक्षा, विदेश मामले और संचार पर अपनी शक्तियां सौंपते थे।
                                                    • \n\t
                                                  \n\t
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • माउंटबेटन योजना:\n\t
                                                    \n\t\t
                                                  • यह अधिनियम भारत के अंतिम वायसराय लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन द्वारा प्रस्तावित 3 जून की योजना पर आधारित था, जिसका उद्देश्य भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम संघ के बीच सांप्रदायिक गतिरोध को हल करना था।
                                                    • \n\t
                                                  \n\t
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • संधियों की समाप्ति:\n\t
                                                    \n\t\t
                                                  • अधिनियम में स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया था कि राजमुकुट और राज्यों के बीच सभी वाणिज्यिक और वित्तीय समझौते भी समाप्त हो जाएंगे, जिससे प्रशासनिक निरंतरता बनाए रखने के लिए यथास्थिति समझौतों (Standstill Agreements) के निर्माण की आवश्यकता होगी।
                                                    • \n\t
                                                  \n\t
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • अपवाद मामले:\n\t
                                                    \n\t\t
                                                  • जबकि अधिकांश राज्य अगस्त 1947 तक किसी एक अधिराज्य में शामिल हो गए थे, हैदराबाद, जूनागढ़ और जम्मू और कश्मीर जैसे राज्यों ने शुरू में संकोच किया या स्वतंत्रता की मांग की, जिससे आगे राजनीतिक और सैन्य हस्तक्षेप हुए।
                                                    • \n\t

                                                \n\n7c:T101e,\nThe correct answer is The establishment of a comprehensive system of education from the primary to the university level, with English as the medium of instruction at higher levels..\n\n

                                                Key Points

                                                \n\n
                                                  \n\t
                                                • Wood's Despatch of 1854 is famously known as the Magna Carta of English Education in India, as it was the first document to provide a comprehensive plan for the spread of education.
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • Prepared by Sir Charles Wood, the then President of the Board of Control, the despatch was addressed to Lord Dalhousie, the Governor-General of India.
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • It proposed a structured educational hierarchy consisting of Primary Schools at the bottom, followed by Middle Schools, High Schools, Colleges, and Universities.
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • The despatch recommended that English be the medium of instruction for higher education (University level) while vernacular languages (local mother tongues) be used at the school level to ensure wider reach.
                                                  • \n\t
                                                • It advised the establishment of Universities in the presidency towns of Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras, modeled after the University of London, to regulate and conduct examinations.
                                                  • \n
                                                \n\n

                                                 Additional Information

                                                \n\n

                                                    \nWhich of the following was a key recommendation of this despatch?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The immediate vernacularization of all levels of education."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The establishment of a comprehensive system of education from the primary to the university level, with English as the medium of instruction at higher levels."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">The complete privatization of the education sector in India.</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">The exclusive focus on the training of religious leaders and scholars.</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "1854 के "वुड का प्रेषण" ने भारतीय शिक्षा प्रणाली में कई महत्वपूर्ण बदलावों की सिफारिश की।

                                                    Key Points

                                                    \n\n
                                                      \n\t
                                                    • Wood's Despatch of 1854 is famously known as the Magna Carta of English Education in India, as it was the first document to provide a comprehensive plan for the spread of education.
                                                      • \n\t
                                                    • Prepared by Sir Charles Wood, the then President of the Board of Control, the despatch was addressed to Lord Dalhousie, the Governor-General of India.
                                                      • \n\t
                                                    • It proposed a structured educational hierarchy consisting of Primary Schools at the bottom, followed by Middle Schools, High Schools, Colleges, and Universities.
                                                      • \n\t
                                                    • The despatch recommended that English be the medium of instruction for higher education (University level) while vernacular languages (local mother tongues) be used at the school level to ensure wider reach.
                                                      • \n\t
                                                    • It advised the establishment of Universities in the presidency towns of Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras, modeled after the University of London, to regulate and conduct examinations.
                                                      • \n
                                                    \n\n

                                                     Additional Information

                                                    \n\n
                                                      \n\t
                                                    • Administrative Framework:\n\n\t
                                                        \n\t\t
                                                      • It recommended the creation of a Department of Public Instruction (DPI) in every province to supervise educational activities and maintain standards.
                                                        • \n\t
                                                      \n\t
                                                      • \n\t
                                                    • Financial Support and Privatization:\n\t
                                                        \n\t\t

                                                          Key Points

                                                          \n\n
                                                            \n\t
                                                          • Ghoomar is a highly popular folk dance performed in Haryana, particularly in the regions adjoining Rajasthan such as Bhiwani, Hisar, Rohtak, and Sirsa.
                                                            • \n\t
                                                          • The dance is exclusively performed by women who wear traditional colorful costumes including the Ghagra (a long flared skirt) and a veil, creating a vibrant visual display as they twirl.
                                                            • \n\t
                                                          • The term is derived from the word ghoomna, which signifies the graceful circular movements and pirouettes executed by the dancers while moving in a clockwise and anti-clockwise direction.
                                                            • \n\t
                                                          • It is typically showcased during significant cultural festivals such as Holi, Gangaur, and Teej, as well as during wedding ceremonies to celebrate fertility and joy.
                                                            • \n\t
                                                          • While it shares its name and core style with the state dance of Rajasthan, the Haryanvi version has distinct local variations in rhythm and folk songs.

                                                                        Key Points

                                                                        • Thang-Ta is a traditional martial art form from the state of Manipur, technically known as Huyen Lallong, which translates to 'the art of steps and lanes'.
                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                        • The name is derived from its primary weapons: Thang (sword) and Ta (spear), though practitioners also utilize the Chungoi (shield) and various other bladed instruments.
                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                        • It features two main components: the ritualistic aspects related to tantric practices and the physical aspects involving high-energy combat sequences, complex footwork, and athletic maneuvers.
                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                        • Historically, this art form was a vital defense mechanism for the Meitei warriors of the Manipur Kingdom; however, it was suppressed during the British colonial era and later revived as a performing art.
                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                        • The dance demonstrates the perfect coordination between the shield and the sword, symbolizing the protection of the land and the courage of the Manipuri people.
                                                                          • \n

                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • It features two main components: the ritualistic aspects related to tantric practices and the physical aspects involving high-energy combat sequences, complex footwork, and athletic maneuvers.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • Historically, this art form was a vital defense mechanism for the Meitei warriors of the Manipur Kingdom; however, it was suppressed during the British colonial era and later revived as a performing art.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • The dance demonstrates the perfect coordination between the shield and the sword, symbolizing the protection of the land and the courage of the Manipuri people.

                                                                             Additional Information

                                                                            \n\n
                                                                              \n\t

                                                                                • \n\t\t

                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                \n\t\t

                                                                                • \n\t\t

                                                                              \n\t
                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                \n\t\t

                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                              • Kartal Cholom is another variant performed using large cymbals, emphasizing rhythmic precision and body balance.
                                                                                • \n\t

                                                                            Key Points 

                                                                            \n\n
                                                                              \n\t
                                                                            • थांग-टा मणिपुर राज्य का एक पारंपरिक युद्ध कला  रूप है, जिसे तकनीकी रूप से हुयेन लालोंग (Huyen Lallong) के रूप में जाना जाता है, जिसका अनुवाद 'कदमों और गलियों की कला' है।
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • यह नाम इसके प्राथमिक हथियारों से लिया गया है: थांग (तलवार) और टा (भाला), हालांकि अभ्यासकर्ता चुंगोई (ढाल) और विभिन्न अन्य धारदार उपकरणों का भी उपयोग करते हैं।
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • इसमें दो मुख्य घटक शामिल हैं: तांत्रिक प्रथाओं से संबंधित अनुष्ठानिक पहलू और उच्च-ऊर्जा वाले युद्ध दृश्यों, जटिल फुटवर्क और एथलेटिक युद्धाभ्यास से जुड़े शारीरिक पहलू।
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह कला रूप मणिपुर साम्राज्य के मैतेई योद्धाओं के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण रक्षा तंत्र था; हालाँकि, ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान इसे दबा दिया गया था और बाद में एक प्रदर्शन कला के रूप में पुनर्जीवित किया गया।
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • यह नृत्य ढाल और तलवार के बीच पूर्ण समन्वय को प्रदर्शित करता है, जो भूमि की सुरक्षा और मणिपुरी लोगों के साहस का प्रतीक है।

                                                                            \n\n88:Tf52,\nThe correct answer is Mahendravarman I.\n\n

                                                                            Key Points

                                                                            \n\n
                                                                              \n\t
                                                                            • Dakshinchitra is an ancient treatise or a commentary on the art of painting that provides insights into the aesthetic traditions of early South India.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • The work was compiled under the royal patronage of the Pallava ruler Mahendravarman I, who reigned from approximately 600 to 630 CE.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • Mahendravarman I was a great scholar and artist, often referred to by the title Chitrakarapuli (Tiger among painters) due to his profound mastery and promotion of the fine arts.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • He was also known as Vichitrachitta (Curious-minded), reflecting his innovative approach to temple architecture, specifically the introduction of rock-cut temples in the Tamil country, such as the Mandagapattu temple.
                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                            • His interest in documentation and theory led to the compilation of Dakshinchitra, which served as a significant reference for the Pallava style of mural painting, remnants of which can be found in Sittannavasal.
                                                                              • \n
                                                                            \n\n

                                                                             Additional Information

                                                                            \n\n
                                                                              \n\t

                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                \n\t
