                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ऊंचाई = 30 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          वर्गाकार टाइल की भुजा = 10 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          घनाभ का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2 x (lb + bh + hl)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          वर्गाकार टाइल का क्षेत्रफल = भुजा x भुजा

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          टाइलों की संख्या = कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ÷ एक टाइल का क्षेत्रफल

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2 x (2400 + 1200 + 1800)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2 x 5400

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 10800 सेमी2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ एक टाइल का क्षेत्रफल = 10 x 10 = 100 सेमी2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ टाइलों की संख्या = 10800 ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ टाइलों की संख्या = 108

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 108 है।

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Filled volume = 600 cm3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ In liters = 600 ÷ 1000

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ In liters = 0.6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 0.6 liters.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          लंबाई = 20 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          चौड़ाई = 20 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ऊंचाई = 15 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          भरा हुआ आयतन = 10%

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          घनाभ का आयतन = लंबाई x चौड़ाई x ऊंचाई

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          1 लीटर = 1000 सेमी3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ आयतन = 20 x 20 x 15

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ आयतन = 6000 सेमी3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ भरा हुआ आयतन = 10 ÷ 100 x 6000

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ भरा हुआ आयतन = 600 सेमी3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ लीटर में = 600 ÷ 1000

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ लीटर में = 0.6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 0.6 लीटर है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Mensuration"], "concept": "Mensuration", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985e993fef3393e43be191e", "qs_no": 17, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "A cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base, 1/3rd from the top. What is the ratio of the volumes of the smaller top cone to the whole cone?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1:27&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">2:17</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">3:17</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">5:27</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक शंकु को उसके आधार के समांतर एक समतल द्वारा शीर्ष से 1/3 भाग पर काटा जाता है। शीर्ष पर स्थित छोटे शंकु के आयतन का पूरे शंकु के आयतन से अनुपात क्या है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1:27"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2:17"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "3:17"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "5:27"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Plane cuts cone at 1/3 height from top

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Height ratio (small cone : original cone) = 1 : 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Volume of cone ∝ (Height)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume ratio = (1 ÷ 3)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume ratio = 1 ÷ 27

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 1 : 27.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          एक समतल शंकु को ऊपर से 1/3 ऊंचाई पर काटता है

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ऊंचाई अनुपात (छोटा शंकु : मूल शंकु) = 1 : 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          शंकु का आयतन ∝ (ऊंचाई)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ आयतन अनुपात = (1 ÷ 3)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          3.25,2.5 and 4.75

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Average = (Sum of values) ÷ (Number of values)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Sum of values = 3.25 + 2.5 + 4.75

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Sum of values = 10.5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Average = 10.5 ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Average = 3.5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 3.5.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          3.25, 2.5 और 4.75

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          औसत = (मानों का योग) ÷ (मानों की संख्या)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ मानों का योग = 3.25 + 2.5 + 4.75

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ मानों का योग = 10.5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ औसत = 10.5 ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ औसत = 3.5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 3.5 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Average"], "concept": "Average", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f11018d28754cefe4e23", "qs_no": 24, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Which of the following is a terminating decimal?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "7/ 20"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">11/ 30</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">13/ 45</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">8 /33</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक सांत दशमलव है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "​7/ 20"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "11/ 30"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "13/ 45"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "8 /33"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          7 ÷ 20

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          11 ÷ 30

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          13 ÷ 45

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          8 ÷ 33

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          A fraction has a terminating decimal if denominator has only prime factors 2 and/or 5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 20 = 2 × 2 × 5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Only 2 and 5 → terminating

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5 → contains 3 → non-terminating

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 45 = 3 × 3 × 5 → contains 3 → non-terminating

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 33 = 3 × 11 → contains 3, 11 → non-terminating

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 7 ÷ 20.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          7 ÷ 20

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          11 ÷ 30

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          13 ÷ 45

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          8 ÷ 33

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          एक भिन्न का दशमलव निरूपण सांत होता है यदि हर में केवल अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2 और/या 5 हों।

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 20 = 2 x 2 x 5

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ केवल 2 और 5 → सांत

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 30 = 2 x 3 x 5 → 3 शामिल है → असांत

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 45 = 3 x 3 x 5 → 3 शामिल है → असांत

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 33 = 3 x 11 → 3, 11 शामिल हैं → असांत

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 7 ÷ 20 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Number System"], "concept": "Number System", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f161e70b7c1b86036571", "qs_no": 25, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If a regular polygon has 44 diagonals, how many sides does it have?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">14</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">13</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">11</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि एक समबहुभुज में 44 विकर्ण हैं, तो उसकी कितनी भुजाएँ होंगी?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "14"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "13"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "11"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Total diagonals = 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Number of diagonals in a polygon = n(n-3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) ÷ 2 = 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) = 44 × 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) = 88

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n2 - 3n - 88 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Solve: n = 11 (only positive integer solution)

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 11.

                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          कुल विकर्ण = 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          एक बहुभुज में विकर्णों की संख्या = n(n-3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) ÷ 2 = 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) = 44 x 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n(n-3) = 88

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n2 - 3n - 88 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ हल करें: n = 11 (केवल धनात्मक पूर्णांक हल)

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 11 है।

                                                                                                                                          ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f1ab8ccde32c6d54b563", "qs_no": 26, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If the sum of the interior angles of a regular polygon is equal to the sum of its exterior angles, determine the number of sides in the polygon.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "5"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "4"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "3"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि किसी सम बहुभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग उसके बाह्य कोणों के योग के बराबर है, तो बहुभुज में भुजाओं की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "5"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "4"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "3"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of interior angles = Sum of exterior angles

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of interior angles = (n - 2) × 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of exterior angles = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (n - 2) × 180 = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 180n - 360 = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 180n = 720

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 720 ÷ 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 4.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          आंतरिक कोणों का योग = बाह्य कोणों का योग

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          आंतरिक कोणों का योग = (n - 2) x 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          बाह्य कोणों का योग = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (n - 2) x 180 = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 180n - 360 = 360

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 180n = 720

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 720 ÷ 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 4 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f22ad447f97fc606cfe6", "qs_no": 27, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If the sum of the interior angles of a regular polygon is 2520°, determine the number of sides and the total number of diagonals of the polygon.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "16 sides, 104 diagonals"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">14 sides, 94 diagonals&nbsp;</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">18 sides, 104 diagonals</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">14 sides, 84 diagonals</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि एक नियमित बहुभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग 2520° है, तो बहुभुज की भुजाओं की संख्या और विकणों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": " 16 भुजाएँ, 104 विकर्ण"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "14 भुजाएँ, 94 विकर्ण"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": " 18 भुजाएँ, 104 विकर्ण"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": " 14 भुजाएँ, 84 विकर्ण"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of interior angles = 2520°

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Number of diagonals = n × (n − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (n − 2) × 180 = 2520

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n − 2 = 2520 ÷ 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n − 2 = 14

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of diagonals = 16 × (16 − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of diagonals = 16 × 13 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of diagonals = 208 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of diagonals = 104

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 16 sides and 104 diagonals.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 2520°

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          आंतरिक कोणों का योग = (n − 2) x 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          विकर्णों की संख्या = n x (n − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (n − 2) x 180 = 2520

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n − 2 = 2520 ÷ 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n − 2 = 14

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ n = 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्णों की संख्या = 16 x (16 − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्णों की संख्या = 16 x 13 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्णों की संख्या = 208 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्णों की संख्या = 104

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 16 भुजाएँ और 104 विकर्ण हैं।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f291c09ad4f153599fc2", "qs_no": 28, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "A quadrilateral is divided into two triangles by a diagonal of 13 cm. If both triangles have height 12 cm, find total area.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "156 cm&sup2;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">312 cm&sup2;</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">240 cm&sup2;</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">280 cm&sup2;</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक चतुर्भुज को 13 सेमी विकर्ण द्वारा दो त्रिभुजों में विभाजित किया गया है। यदि दोनों त्रिभुों की ऊँचाई 12 सेमी है, तो कुल क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "156 सेमी²"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "312 सेमी ²"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "240 सेमी²"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "280 सेमी²"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Diagonal = 13 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Height of each triangle = 12 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Height

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area of one triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × 13 × 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area of one triangle = 78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Total area = 78 + 78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Total area = 156

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 156 cm2.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          विकर्ण = 13 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रत्येक त्रिभुज की ऊंचाई = 12 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (1 ÷ 2) x आधार x ऊंचाई

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ एक त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (1 ÷ 2) x 13 x 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ एक त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = 78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कुल क्षेत्रफल = 78 + 78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कुल क्षेत्रफल = 156

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 156 सेमी2 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985f2e9e70b7c1b86038418", "qs_no": 29, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If the square root of a number is 0.25 times the number itself, find the number.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">16</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">25</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">36</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि किसी संख्या का वर्गमूल स्वयं संख्या का 0.25 गुना है, तो वह संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "16"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "25"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "36"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          √N = 0.25 × N

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          If a = b, then a2 = b2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (√N)2 = (0.25 × N)2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 0.0625 × N2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1 = 0.0625 × N

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 1 ÷ 0.0625

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 16.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          √N = 0.25 x N

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          यदि a = b, तो a2 = b2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (√N)2 = (0.25 x N)2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 0.0625 x N2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1 = 0.0625 x N

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 1 ÷ 0.0625

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ N = 16
