                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Exterior angle = Sum of opposite interior angles

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Angles opposite equal sides ar", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Time and Work"], "concept": "Time & Work", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985fdf627307c1760f2b9b6", "qs_no": 45, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "The chords AB and CD of a circle are equidistant from the center of the circle. If the length of the chord AB = 12 cm. What is the length of the chord CD?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "4 cm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">6 cm</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">8 cm</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">12 cm</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक वृत्त की जीवाएँ AB और CD वृत्त के केंद्र से समान दूरी पर हैं। अगर जीवा AB की लंबाई 12 सेमी है, तो जीवा CD की लंबाई क्या है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "4 सेमी"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6 सेमी"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "8 सेमी"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "12 सेमी"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Chords AB and CD are equidistant from center

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Length of chord AB = 12 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Chords equidistant from the center of a circle are equal in length

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Length of chord CD = Length of chord AB

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Length of chord CD = 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          जीवा AB और CD केंद्र से समान दूरी पर हैं

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          जीवा AB की लंबाई = 12 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          एक वृत्त के केंद्र से समान दूरी पर स्थित जीवाएँ लंबाई में बराबर होती हैं

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ जीवा CD की लंबाई = जीवा AB की लंबाई

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ जीवा CD की लंबाई = 12 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 12 सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985fe60cebd9b15bcc0aced", "qs_no": 46, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Given that the curved surface area of a hemisphere is 2772 cm², determine the radius of the hemisphere", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "21 cm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">31 cm</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">41 cm</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">20 cm</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "दिया गया है कि एक अर्थगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 2772 वर्ग सेंटीमीटर है, अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "21 सेंटीमीटर"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "31 सेंटीमीटर"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "41 सेंटीमीटर"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "20 सेंटीमीटर"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2772 cm2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2πr2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          π = 22/7

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r2 = 2772

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (44/7) × r2 = 2772

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = (2772 × 7) ÷ 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = 441

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = √441

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = 21

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.

                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2772 सेमी2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2πr2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          π = 22/7

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2 x (22/7) x r2 = 2772

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (44/7) x r2 = 2772

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = (2772 x 7) ÷ 44

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = 441

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = √441

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = 21

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 21 सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                          ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Mensuration"], "concept": "Mensuration", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985febcfef3393e43bfd297", "qs_no": 47, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "In triangle ABC, if the coordinates of the centroid are (3,4), and two vertices are (1,2) and (5,6), find the third vertex.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(3,4)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">(2,3)</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">&nbsp;(4,5)</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">(3,5)&nbsp;</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "त्रिभुज ABC में, अगर केन्द्रक के निर्देशांक (3,4) हैं, और दो शीर्ष (1,2) और (5,6) हैं, तो तीसरा शीर्ष ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(3,4)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(2,3)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": " (4,5)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(3,5) "}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Centroid = (3, 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          First vertex = (1, 2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Second vertex = (5, 6)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Centroid = ( (x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3 )

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 + 5 + x) ÷ 3 = 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6 + x = 9

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (2 + 6 + y) ÷ 3 = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 8 + y = 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is (3, 4).

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          केन्द्रक = (3, 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          पहला शीर्ष = (1, 2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          दूसरा शीर्ष = (5, 6)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          केन्द्रक = ( (x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3 )

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 + 5 + x) ÷ 3 = 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6 + x = 9

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (2 + 6 + y) ÷ 3 = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 8 + y = 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर (3, 4) है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985ff1372b111d5f9c7da73", "qs_no": 48, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "A cone is cut parallel to its base such that the upper part is 1/3 of the original height. Find the ratio of volumes of the smaller cone to the original.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1:27"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">1:9</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">1:8</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">1:3</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक शंकु को उसके आधार के समांतर इस प्रकार काटा गया है कि उसका ऊपरी भाग मूल ऊँचाई का 1/3 है। छोटे शंकु के आयतन का मूल शंकु के आयतन से अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1:27"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1:9"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "1:8"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1:3"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Height ratio (small cone : original cone) = 1 : 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Volume of cone ∝ (Height)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume ratio = (1 ÷ 3)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume ratio = 1 ÷ 27

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 1 : 27.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ऊंचाई अनुपात (छोटा शंकु : मूल शंकु) = 1 : 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          शंकु का आयतन ∝ (ऊंचाई)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ आयतन अनुपात = (1 ÷ 3)3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ आयतन अनुपात = 1 ÷ 27

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 1 : 27 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Mensuration"], "concept": "Mensuration", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985ff6a5efbd57a33f9eb29", "qs_no": 49, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "In isosceles triangle ABC, where sides AB and AC are equal, the exterior angle at vertex B measures 130°. What is the measure of angle A?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "50&deg;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">65&deg;</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">80&deg;</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">130&deg;</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज ABC में, जहाँ भुजाएँ AB और AC बराबर हैं, शीर्ष B पर बना बाह्य कोण 130° है। कोण A का माप क्या है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "50°"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "65°"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "80°"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "130°"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          AB = AC

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Exterior angle at B = 130°

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Exterior angle = Sum of opposite interior angles

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Angles opposite equal sides are equal

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Exterior angle at B = A + C

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 130 = A + C

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ C = B

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + B + C = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 2B = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ B = 180 − 130 = 50

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 2 × 50 = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 100 = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A = 80

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 80°.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          AB = AC

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          B पर बाह्य कोण = 130°

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          बाह्य कोण = विपरीत आंतरिक कोणों का योग

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          बराबर भुजाओं के विपरीत कोण बराबर होते हैं

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ B पर बाह्य कोण = A + C

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 130 = A + C

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ C = B

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + B + C = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 2B = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ B = 180 − 130 = 50

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 2 x 50 = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A + 100 = 180

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ A = 80

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 80° है।

                                                                                                                                          \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6985ffc772b111d5f9c7ec7f", "qs_no": 50, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "In a circle with center O, a chord AB is drawn such that a tangent at A makes an angle of 30" with chord AB. Find ∠AOB.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "60&deg;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">90&deg;</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">120&deg;</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);">30&deg;</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "केंद्र ० वाले एक वृत्त में, एक जीवा AB इस प्रकार खींची गई है कि A पर एक स्पर्श रेखा जीवा AB के साथ 30° का कोण बनाती है। ∠AOB ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "60°"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "90°"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "120°"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "30°"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Tangent at A makes an angle of 30° with chord AB

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Circle with center O

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Angle between tangent and chord = angle subtended by chord at center ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Angle subtended by chord at center = 2 × angle between tangent and chord

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Angle between tangent and chord = 30°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Angle subtended by chord at center = 2 × 30°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Angle subtended by chord at center = 60°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 60°.

                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                          दिया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          A पर स्पर्श रेखा जीवा AB के साथ 30° का कोण बनाती है

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          केंद्र O वाला वृत्त

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          स्पर्श रेखा और जीवा के बीच का कोण = केंद्र पर जीवा द्वारा अंतरित कोण ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          केंद्र पर जीवा द्वारा अंतरित कोण = 2 x स्पर्श रेखा और जीवा के बीच का कोण

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ स्पर्श रेखा और जीवा के बीच का कोण = 30°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ केंद्र पर जीवा द्वारा अंतरित कोण = 2 x 30°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ केंद्र पर जीवा द्वारा अंतरित कोण = 60°

                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 60° है।

                                                                                                                                          ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}]}, {"section_id": "68d6a87e0cd9a3d9e623a748", "section_name": "English Comprehension", "q_count": 50, "max_marks": 50.0, "questions": [{"qid": "698602fe4c09c43562a2f4dc", "qs_no": 1, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Identify the correct spelling of the misspelled word.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "government"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "goverment"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "govarnment"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "goverenment"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\nQuestion 1: Identify the correct spelling of the misspelled word.\n\n

                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'Option (1)' i.e. government.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                          • The word 'government' refers to the group of people with the authority to govern a country or state; a particular system of ministry in office. (सरकार)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The government is implementing new laws to protect the environment.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • The correct spelling is 'government', which is formed by adding the suffix '-ment' to the root verb 'govern'. It is essential to include the letter 'n' before the suffix. (शासन)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: A stable government is necessary for the economic growth of any nation.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, the correct answer is- government
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                          • goverment (गलत वर्तनी): This is a common misspelling where the letter 'n' is omitted.\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: Many students mistakenly write goverment instead of government because the 'n' is often silent in casual speech.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • govarnment (गलत वर्तनी): This spelling is incorrect because it uses the vowel 'a' instead of 'e' in the second syllable.\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The spelling govarnment does not exist in standard English.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • The given sentence is in the Active Voice and contains a Modal Verb ('ought to').
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • To convert a sentence with a Modal Verb into Passive Voice, the standard grammatical structure is: New Subject (Original Object) + Modal Verb + be + Past Participle (V3) + by + New Object (Original Subject).
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • Breakdown of the active sentence:\n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                              • Subject: You
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Modal Verb: ought to
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Main Verb: respect
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Object: elders
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • Applying the Passive Voice transformation:\n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                              • Elders moves to the subject position.
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Ought to is followed by be and the past participle respected.
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • The original subject you follows the preposition by.
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • This results in the sentence: Elders ought to be respected by you.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • Option 2 is incorrect because it replaces the specific modal ought to with should. While they convey similar meanings of obligation, the modal used in the active voice should be retained in the passive transformation.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • Option 3 is grammatically incorrect as it lacks the auxiliary verb and modal structure required for the passive form.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • Option 4 is incorrect because it changes the pronoun you to me, which changes the intended meaning and the identity of the agent.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            Additional Information
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Ought to is a Semi-Modal Verb primarily used to indicate moral obligation, duty, or a high degree of probability.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • When changing from active to passive, pronouns usually change their case (e.g., 'I' becomes 'me', 'he' becomes 'him'), but you remains you in both subject and object positions.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            • The Past Participle (V3) form of the verb is a mandatory component of all Passive Voice constructions.

                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is Will my daughter be taught chess?

                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                              Key Points
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                              • The given sentence is in the Active Voice and follows the Interrogative structure of the Future Simple Tense using the modal verb will.
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • To convert an interrogative sentence with a modal verb into Passive Voice, the following structure is used: Modal + Object (New Subject) + be + V3 (Past Participle) + by + Subject (New Object).
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • The original components are:\n
                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                • Subject: you
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • Verb: teach
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • Direct Object: chess
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • Indirect Object: my daughter
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • In the passive transformation:\n
                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                • The indirect object my daughter becomes the subject.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • The modal will remains will to maintain the Future Tense (unlike in Narration where it might change to 'would').
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • The auxiliary be is added.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                • The verb teach changes to its past participle form taught.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Therefore, the correct construction is: Will my daughter be taught chess? (The agent 'by you' is implied and often omitted in such questions).
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Option 2, 3, and 4 are incorrect because they change the modal verb to could, can, or would, which changes the mood and meaning of the sentence.
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                              Additional Information
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                              • A Ditransitive Verb like teach has two objects. This sentence can also be converted to passive using the direct object: Will chess be taught to my daughter?
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • Key distinction: In Voice, the tense remains the same. In Narration (Direct/Indirect), the tense typically shifts back (e.g., will becomes would).
                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                              • The Past Participle (V3) forms of 'teach' are taught, and it remains the same for the Past Tense (V2).

                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                • The word Gregarious is derived from the Latin root 'grex' (meaning flock or herd), which originally described animals that live in groups before being applied to human social behavior.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                    • Flattery refers to the act of giving excessive, often insincere praise to someone, typically to further one's own interests or gain favor.
                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                    • Adulation means extreme admiration or excessive praise. Since both words describe a high degree of praise (often more than is deserved), Adulation is the correct synonym.
                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                    • Delegate is a noun or verb referring to a person authorized to represent others or the act of entrusting a task to another person.
